attacks.name: Chains of Damnation
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Hex|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

attacks.name: Flames of Hell
steps: If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved the target character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Penance Stare
steps: Add dice to the attack roll equal to the amount of |!power| the target character has, to a maximum of 5.
Instead of gaining |!power| for the |!damage| dealt by this attack, the target character loses one |!power| for each |!damage| dealt.

superPowers.name: Hell on Wheels
superPowers.body: Advance this character |!range_large|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Wicked‘s Judgement
superPowers.body: After an attack made by a character within |!range| 3 of this character is resolved, if that attack targeted another allied character, this character may use this superpower. The attacking character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| in its attack roll.

superPowers.name: Spirit of Vengeance
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting another allied character is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character gains 1 |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 7 to 8 on Healthy side.
Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Injured side.
Spirit of Vengeance does not require the attacking character to be within |!range| 3 of Ghost Rider.
Ghost Rider is now immune to Bleed, Hex, Incinerate and Poison.
The French version of the card in CP220 incorrectly gives Ghost Rider the Flight superpower
